lines: AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!
As the monsterーa Shadowーdisappeared with a cry of despair, the swarm of Will-o'-wisps disappeared as well, as if they had never been there at all.
Me
Phew. We made it through somehow... But I must say, you have ridiculous strength.
I began talking to the masked girl who had sliced through the Shadow with a single stroke of her sword.
She might have been on the same level as some of the ace Taimanin of Gosha Academy that I knew such as Mizuki Yukikaze or Kamimura Maika.
Her strength in wiping out that many of them, the countless Will-o'-wisps, had been overwhelming.
Masked Girl
Not really... Forget about that, you're the one that was amazing.
Me
Hm? Me?
Masked Girl
Yeah, your knowledge about magical traps. Without it, I think I would have been in a bit of trouble. Thanks for the help.
The masked girl held out her right hand in admiration.
Me
I'm not a big deal or anything either... Anyway, I'm Fuma Kotaro.
I shook her hand in response.
Masked Girl
Fuma!? You're that Fuma...?
She stared at me in surprise.
Me
? Do you know about me?
Masked Girl
You're the captain of the Independent Commando Unit, right? I've heard rumors.
Me
Haha, I bet it was some kind of stupid rumor?
Masked Girl
No. It was a rumor about your great efforts. ーI'm Jisai, Shishigami Jisai.
The girl smiled and told me her name.
Me
Shishigami, hmーYou're a Taimanin, right? Do you belong to a unit working outside of Gosha?
I hadn't known there were people with this kind of potential.
Shishigami Jisai
No. I'm also a student at Gosha Academy, just like you.
Me
Eh? You are...!?
Jisai
Yes. Unlike famous you, I don't like to stand out.
Me
It's not like I stand out because I like it, though...
The difficulties with Gaiza, the Independent Commando Unit, and so on... Trouble just found its way to me...
Me
Anyway, what is a student from Gosha doing in this place?
Me
I heard that this store is run by a black market broker who is connected to the Devildom. It's not a place for upstanding people.
Incidentally, I had been asked by Kiryu-sensei to run an errand and go to this store to grab some Devildom-produced materials he had ordered.
Apparently, he had ordered them a few days ago, but they had never arrived.
And no matter how many inquiries he made, the store didn't respond, so he had sent me to get his order.
Jisai
I received a tip. From the owner of this storeーfrom the black market broker you spoke about.
Me
A tip...?
Jisai
Yes. Information about the Nisha Clan members who recently began to work with Nomad.
Jisai
He seems to be connected to "Dragon Gate," so most likely that's how he got the information.
Me
The Nisha Clan? ーInformation about Gaiza and his men!?
An unexpected name had suddenly come up.
If they were involved, then I couldn't say that it didn't concern me.
Jisai
Didn't you know? I thought you had come here for the same reason.
Me
Eh!? No, I've just got... a small errand to run...
Compared to the masked girl, it was a pretty idiotic reason.
Jisai
An errand?
Me
Ah, no, it's nothing!! Anyway, you came here and suddenly you were attacked by those Will-o'-wisps, right?
Jisai
Yes. The owner I received the tip from isn't here and I really don't get what's going on...
Me
Hmm...
Once again I looked around the dimly lit store.
There were only the two of us in the store, and according to Shishigami, there was no indication the owner would show up.
Me
It's kind of creepy... If the all-important owner isn't here, we'd better come back later.
Jisai
No, that won't work either.
Shishigami calmly shook her head.
Me
Won't work? What do you mean?
Jisai
Try it and you'll see. It seems you were able to get in the store... but most likely you won't be able to get out.
Me
Huh!?
No, no, there was no way that I wouldn't be able to get outー
I quickly opened the door and went outside.
Well, at least I should have been outside...
Me
You're right...
What I saw in front of me was the same dimly lit store.
I had opened the door and should have made it outside, but somehow I was inside the store again...
Jisai
See? Do you know why that happens?
Me
Not sure, but... this is probably connected to the Will-o'-wisp trap from earlier somehow...
It was only natural when you thought about it.
No matter how many endlessly appearing Will-o'-wisps attacked the intruder, if running away was possible everything would be meaningless.
With the two elements combined, the sealed off space and the monsters, the trap was complete.
Jisai
So this is the magical trap you were talking about before.
Me
Yeah... And it looks like a pretty advanced one, as far as I can tell.
A feat like cutting off a section of space was impossible for an amateurish practitioner.
Jisai
Hmm, you're pretty knowledgeable. You even know what kind of traps are out there.
Me
All that time wasted reading books comes in handy in situations like this.
Me
(That being said, what the hell is going on here...?)
For what purpose had a trap like this been set?
It was a total coincidence that I had come here... so it was unlikely that it was a trap specifically for me.
Then was it aimed at this masked girlー?
Me
Hey, Shishigami. Can you think of anybody who would be after you?
Jisai
Hmm...?
Me
I don't think this trap was set for me... Which would mean, by the process of elimination, that you were the target.
Jisai
I-I see... I mean, I can't say that I've never given anyone reason to hate me, but...
Jisai
But I don't think I did something to the extent that someone would set a trap like this for me.
Me
Hmm. In that caseー
It meant that, at the moment, the reason was completely unknown.
Jisai
I don't know, but... I think there might be someone who knows the reason.
Me
What?
Shishigami suddenly lowered her voice and nodded at me slightly.
And thenー
Jisai
ーYou over there!! Come out! I know you're hiding!!
She called out with a sharp voice and at the same time threw a kunaiー
And with a crisp "shink!" the tip pierced the pillar at the back of the store.
Me
Eh!? You areー
Slowly, like a shadow oozing out, a tall man appeared from behind the pillar.
Ah, my apologies. I didn't mean to hide, butー
